name: A level-15 Stalking Venomancer switches to Fortitude with its chained Expulsion entry (#8716)
contract: #8716: a level-15 Venomancer in Stalking could not switch to Fortitude while Rot worked. The client's switch upload carries the zero-cost automatic entries chained on the new identity. Fortitude (ChrSpecs 52) chains entry 31202 Expulsion (805094, AE 0, TE 0, Required 4054 Exposed Flesh + 7229 Hive Instinct) on identity 4054 Exposed Flesh (92144) and signature 7229 Hive Instinct (804968). Rot's chained entry 30477 costs 1 TE, so only the Fortitude upload hit the automatic-entry check of #8642 (validated against the live spellbook, which lacks Exposed Flesh before the switch); #8750 validates it against the build the upload leads to. Stalking (53) chains 12201 Widowmaker (804961) on identity 4053 (92143). Venom (Rot, 54) grants identity 4052 (92142). The control adds Stalking entry 12201 to a Fortitude save, which must be refused, so the listed entries demonstrably reach the server.

steps.label: Let login hooks and class synchronisation settle
Choose Stalking with its chained Widowmaker
Expulsion is not known in Stalking
Control: a Stalking entry in a Fortitude save reaches the server and is refused
The refused save leaves Exposed Flesh unknown
Switch from Stalking to Fortitude with the chained Expulsion entry
Fortitude keeps the Hive Instinct signature
Switch from Rot back to Fortitude with the chained Expulsion entry
